title: LEO latent decoder replaced by structured Mirror map
hypothesis: At matched 2D latent dimension and adaptation budget, structured Mirror decoding matches LEO within 1.10x query NRMSE and uses fewer amortized bytes at N=20.
mirror_coordinate: 2D latent m interpreted as Givens angle plus structured offset
success_gate: Every fresh world: Mirror NRMSE <=1.10x LEO and amortized bytes at N=20 lower than LEO.
failure_gate: Quality/byte gate misses or generic decoder wins at similar bytes.
boundaries: Same aligned linear task family as MA-442/443.
No natural task or nonlinear backbone claim.
